message: a void call cannot be used as a value
why: `void` means this call returns nothing: there is no value to store, pass or compare, so a value position (a binding, an argument, one side of an operator) has nothing to put there. Letting it through leaves a hole that only surfaces when the IR is assembled, and that error names a missing node field instead of `this call returns nothing`.
fix: call it as its own statement and drop the binding
if you need an outcome from it, give the callee a return type — `void` is a statement, never an operand
